theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_bu_hds_unif_of_dense
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K : ℝ) (S D : Set (Rn n)) (F : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), 0 < α → 0 ≤ K → IsCompact S → D ⊆ S → S ⊆ closure D → (∀ d ∈ D, ∃ v : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, Tendsto (fun j => F j d) atTop (𝓝 v)) → (∀ j, ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ z' ∈ S, ‖F j z - F j z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) → ∃ G : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), TendstoUniformlyOn F G atTop S
